C-FIX-CAR-DEALER-ALPHA-AND-PRINT.Summary: Make the car-dealer card's out-of-range alpha explicit without changing a single rendered pixel, and drop the debug print that runs on every decoration repaint.
C-FIX-CAR-DEALER-ALPHA-AND-PRINT.Problem: lib/widgets/car_dealer/used/used_car_grid_item.dart:23 paints the card background with Colors.grey.withAlpha(280). The value is outside the documented 0..255 range and there is no assertion guarding it: in the pinned SDK, withAlpha delegates to Color.fromARGB, which masks the channel with `& 0xff`, so 280 silently becomes 24 and the card renders at alpha 24/255 (about 9.4%) — the look the screen has today, reached through undocumented modulo behaviour that the SDK documents as "unexpected effects". Anyone who later "corrects" 280 to 255, or reads the line as a typo for 28, changes the design with no test to catch it. Separately, lib/widgets/car_dealer/legendary/legendary_car_grid_item.dart:363 calls print(configuration.size!.height) as the first statement of CustomDecorationPainter.paint, so every repaint of the legendary card's decoration writes a line to stdout on the build host.

Goals.Goal: Replace the out-of-range alpha with an in-range value that renders identically, so the visible result is provably unchanged.
Leave a comment recording that 280 was the historical value and what it evaluated to, so the intent cannot be re-litigated by accident.
Remove the per-repaint debug print from the decoration painter.
Govern both touched files with GRACE file-local markup, since the graph already declares M-WIDGET-CAR-DEALER but no source file carries its module contract.

Constraints.Constraint: The rendered colour must stay identical: alpha 24/255 after the change, exactly as before it.
Both files are legacy-generation code; keep their existing style (withAlpha rather than withValues, no restyling) so the diff stays reviewable.
No behavioural change to the used or legendary screens, their sorting, images or price-history launch.

NonGoals.NonGoal: The duplicated _buildStatusBadge in the two grid items and the duplicated error block in the two displays are left alone; de-duplication is a refactor with a placement decision and belongs in its own change.

The print calls in lib/services/network_scanner.dart (40), lib/utils/crypto_utils.dart (10), lib/services/telemetry_service.dart (9) and lib/services/udp_service.dart (4) are out of scope; those subsystems are governed separately.
No change to gt7_theme.dart, the telemetry tokens or the app's colour scheme.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No withAlpha argument greater than 255 remains anywhere under lib/.
The used-car card decoration still resolves to alpha 24/255.
No print call remains inside any paint method under lib/widgets/car_dealer/.
Both touched files open with a GRACE module contract, so grace lint reports at least one governed file.

flutter analyze reports at most 178 issues and still zero errors (measured baseline before the change: 179 issues, of which 0 errors, 24 warnings, 155 infos; the info at legendary_car_grid_item.dart:363 is avoid_print and disappears with the print).
grace lint --path . --assertions current reports zero errors.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: ! grep -rnoE 'withAlpha\([0-9]+\)' lib/ | grep -E 'withAlpha\((2[6-9][0-9]|[3-9][0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4,})\)' ; test "$(flutter analyze 2>&1 | grep -cE '^ *(error|warning|info) • ')" -le 178 ; grace lint --path . --assertions current
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The sweep finds no withAlpha argument above 255, the analyzer issue count drops to 178 with zero errors, and grace lint reports zero errors with a non-zero governed-file count. The alpha equivalence is shown by evaluating (24 & 0xff) / 255 = 0.0941176... against the previous (280 & 0xff) / 255 = 0.0941176...

Assumptions.Assumption: The 9.4% grey veil is the intended design, since it is what the author sees today; the change preserves it rather than reinterpreting the value as 28 or 255.
Dart is on PATH for the pinned SDK, which the Dart adapter needs to analyse the newly governed files.
